scale_rule: each product of two scaled operands must stay below 2^46
strong_categories: F1 double/parse/NaN/Inf, F2 Math/, F3 float literal, F9 typed f64 ops (existing :kotoba branches)

groups.computes: Text to number: px/em/%/fr/unitless decimals, integers, counters, media numbers (cssom.core parse-*, layout parse-dbl/parse-px).
groups.range_and_precision_needed: Corpus (measured, scripts/corpus.py): px literals are integer in 1564/1565 (cases.edn) and 1272/1279 (layout_test); unitless numbers carry up to 6 fractional digits (one with 15); code constants carry 4 (13.3333, 11.6667). max |px| 99999.
groups.proposed_scale: lengths Q6 (1/64 px), |raw| <= 2^30 (2^24 px); unitless factors Q10 (1/1024), |raw| <= 2^15 (32.0); at most 6 fractional digits read, rest truncated
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: parse: <= 2^-7 px (half an LSB) per literal, measured exact against Decimal half-up on 15 cases (prototype/px_parse_q6_host.kotoba); digits beyond the 6th are truncated, so a tie there can flip (documented, measured)
groups.product_budget_note: none (no multiplication in the parser; the integer part is guarded < 2^24 before multiplying by 64)

groups.computes: percentage-of, em/rem/% font-size, text-indent %, minmax/track sizes, flexible-length distribution.
groups.range_and_precision_needed: Corpus: percentages are all integer (51+74+19 literals, max 200); em has <= 1 fractional digit (max 60). Hosted result is integer px: (long (Math/round (* basis (/ pct 100.0)))) layout.cljk:3939.
groups.proposed_scale: percent stored as Q10 of a percent (1/1024 %, 100% = 102400, 1000% = 2^20); basis Q6 with |raw| <= 2^25 (2^19 px); one exact integer division by 6553600 (quot)
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: product < 2^45. vs the f64 oracle: identical except at exact x.5 ties, where the oracle rounds down because pct/100.0 is inexact: 1114 of 1,233,197 (integer percent 0..300 x basis 0..4096 px) and 7391 of 122,908,097 (0.01 % steps 0..300 %), zero non-tie differences (measured, native macOS). Example: 29 % of 50 px is 14.5, oracle 14, exact 15.
groups.product_budget_note: basis x 2^-11 % + 2^-7 px for Q6 results

groups.computes: calc()/min/max/clamp evaluation: add/sub of lengths, mul/div by numbers (core eval-calc-node, layout calc-number-at/eval-calc-node).
groups.range_and_precision_needed: No calc literals counted in the corpus script (DECL regex does not separate calc terms); semantics read from core.cljk 1043-1056: result is a long when whole else a double (type distinction disappears in fixed point).
groups.proposed_scale: values Q6, |raw| <= 2^30; factors Q10, |raw| <= 2^15; mul = (v*f)>>10, div = (v<<10)/f
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: product < 2^45; add/sub exact; mul/div <= 2^-7 px each; division by a factor < 1 amplifies prior error by 1/f, so cap nesting (proposal 4 ops => <= 2^-5 px)

groups.computes: Colour parsing: hex bytes to unit floats, rgb()/hsl() tokens, hsl->rgb (domGpu host/color.cljk).
groups.range_and_precision_needed: All channels are floats 0..1 in the hosted API (unit = byte/255). The draw list the kernel consumes is u32 rgb, so 8-bit channels are the natural native type.
groups.proposed_scale: channels and alpha as integers 0..255; hsl hue Q6 degrees [0,360), s/l Q10 fractions; hsl->rgb in Q10
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: Q10 x Q10 = 2^20 (tiny). Bound proposed: +-1 on an 8-bit channel at rounding ties; NOT measured.

groups.computes: 2D transform matrices: translate/scale/rotate/skew/matrix(), composition, origin, flow rotation, round-4 output (layout.cljk 17593-17990).
groups.range_and_precision_needed: Oracle reports 4 decimals (round-4, layout.cljk:17610); uses Math/sin cos tan sqrt abs PI. The native f64 dialect has NO sin/cos/tan/atan2/pow/floor/ceil/round (measured: E2101 on each); only f64-sqrt, f64-abs, f64-to-i64-truncating.
groups.proposed_scale: coefficients Q17, |raw| <= 2^20 (|c| <= 8); local coordinates Q6 with |raw| <= 2^19 (8192 px); sin/cos/tan from a table plus interpolation or CORDIC in Q17
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: product < 2^39 (a long chain of 3 composed matrices < 2^46 only if intermediate shifts are applied after each product). Bound: 2^-16 absolute per coefficient, i.e. 0.125 px worst case at 8192 px, ~0.015 px at 1000 px; the oracle itself rounds to 1e-4. tan() diverges near 90 deg: domain must be clamped (hosted has no clamp).

groups.computes: line-height multiplier, normal = 1.2 x font-size, glyph advance 0.6 x font-size, tab stops, leading, form-control sizing (ceil of average advance), host font hooks (:measure-text x34 mentions, :font-metrics x11, :avg-advance x3).
groups.range_and_precision_needed: Font sizes are fractional in places (UA control font 13.3333, smaller/larger step 1.2). Results are truncated/ceiled to integer px: (long (* 1.2 font-size)).
groups.proposed_scale: font-size Q6; multipliers Q10; results integer px via (fs * m) >> 16; ceil via +0xFFFF before the shift
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: product < 2^45. Oracle differences at exact integers: for 2-decimal multipliers 0.00..5.00 x font size 1..256 the double product truncates one px low in 183 of 128,256 pairs (0.14 %, e.g. 0.29 x 100 = 28.999999999999996); the constants 0.6 and 1.2 are clean for font sizes 1..4096 (0 of 4096 each) (measured, scripts/trunc_oracle.py). Font metrics are host data, not computed: a native port needs an integer metrics table/hook.

groups.computes: flex-grow/shrink distribution, fr tracks, table column widths, multicol balance, absolute/relative placement.
groups.range_and_precision_needed: Factors are doubles (flex-grow default 0.0, shrink 1.0, fr 1.0 in the corpus); distribution uses (long (* target (/ x (double total)))).
groups.proposed_scale: free space Q6; factors Q10; (free * f_i) / sum(f) with one quot; remainder given by largest-remainder rule so the sum is exact
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: product < 2^45 (sum of factors must stay < 2^24 for the divisor). Per item <= 1 px vs oracle; sum equals free space exactly (the hosted truncation loses up to n-1 px). NOT measured.
groups.product_budget_note: quot admitted (compiled on user-v2, probe px_parse_q6_user)

groups.range_and_precision_needed: aspect-ratio is a quotient of two integers in the hosted code ((/ w (double h))).
groups.proposed_scale: keep as an integer pair (num, den <= 2^16) and compute len*num/den with quot; do not store a Q-ratio (Q10 16/9 is 2.8e-4 off => 0.28 px at 1000 px)
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: product < 2^46 for len raw <= 2^30 and num <= 2^16 only; use len <= 2^28

groups.computes: vertical-align length/percentage and inline fragment centring ((/ x 2) sites).
groups.range_and_precision_needed: percent of line-height; halves of integer pixel counts.
groups.proposed_scale: as G02/G06; halves as >>1 (note floor for negatives)
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: half of an odd Q6 raw loses 2^-7 px (measured in the block-width gate: max difference 1 unit of 1/128 px)

groups.computes: HTML step mismatch for number/range inputs (core step-invalid?, tolerance 1e-9).
groups.range_and_precision_needed: Unbounded user-typed decimals: min/max/step attributes of any magnitude.
groups.proposed_scale: DEFER: exact decimal rationals (mantissa i64 + power of ten) rather than Q-format; or leave to a later slice
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: hosted tolerance 1e-9 is not representable; exact test replaces it (behaviour change, to be decided)

groups.computes: opacity clamp 0..1, flex-grow/shrink style numbers, root layout-node scale 1.0.
groups.range_and_precision_needed: opacity multiplies down the tree (multiplicative accumulator).
groups.error_bound_vs_hosted_oracle: product 2^20; error <= 2^-11 per level; final alpha 8-bit

groups.range_and_precision_needed: Used as ordering sentinels, not as quantities.
groups.proposed_scale: integer sentinels (INT64_MAX/MIN) and an integer hop count; no fixed-point needed

groups.range_and_precision_needed: Formatting for inspector/debug text, not the render path.
groups.proposed_scale: DEFER; if needed, Q6 to decimal string by integer division
